summary: SOCRadar Brand Protection Essential: it finds phishing sites and look-alike domains using your brand and watches blocklists and leaks in cloud storage.
value: Fake sites using the brand are found before they deceive customers.
It shows if company IPs or domains end up on blocklists.
Leaks in cloud storage and repositories are spotted.
simple: Finds phishing sites and look-alike domains using your brand, checks whether your IP addresses and domains have landed on blocklists, and watches for leaks in cloud storage, code repositories and malware-analysis services. Automatically files takedown requests for fake domains, social media pages, counterfeit apps and fraudulent sites and tracks them through to completion. For banks — detection of stolen payment cards. Has configurable playbooks with AI agents.
notIncluded: Mobile apps, social media and the dark web come with Business and Ultimate.
classification: The brand protection class was created for SOCRadar.
